title: Invite people — referral bounty
lead: For your own invitee: 100. For the people your invitee brings: 30. Paid from the Million Founders pool, no new coins.
preliminary: Preliminary: point values, the PPL-per-point rate and the season budget can change before mainnet. This is not a promise of income.
needRegister: Register as a founder to get your referral link.
needSignIn: Sign in and connect a wallet to get your referral link.
rules: L1: 100 points for each of your own active invitees.
L2: +30% of what your invitee earned for THEIR active invitees. It is not deducted from your invitee.
Only two levels. This is separate from the 15% fee partner split (70/30).
The program stops when the referral pool is empty. No new coin printing.
activeRules: Verified through the Telegram phone bot or Human Passport.
At least one real testnet action: swap, stake, pool, NFT, token launch or governance vote.
extraRules: {{pts}} points when your active invitee is still acting 7 days after activation.
{{pts2}} points when your active invitee buys PPL in the official sale.
{{pts3}} points when your active invitee joins another project's airdrop on People.
todayLine: Today: {{today}} of {{cap}} points (same daily cap as the main program).
capHint: More than 50 requires ambassador status and manual approval.
poolEmpty: The Season 1 referral pool is empty. New referral points are not credited.
inviteesEmpty: No invitees yet. Share your link.
vestingBody: Referral PPL: 10% liquid immediately, 90% unlocks weekly over 12 months (52 weeks). Each credit vests from the day it was credited.
vestingNote: Claims are recorded in the program ledger. PPL payout happens after mainnet distribution is live.
launchLabel: Add +{{pct}}% of supply for my own referral program
launchHint: Off by default. On top of the mandatory 10% community share. Paid to inviters on their invitees' purchases of this token, same two levels (L2 = 30% of L1), same vesting. Accounting is off-chain on this testnet; the reserved share comes from your own allocation.
launchRegistered: Referral program registered for this token.
launchFailed: Token was created, but the referral program could not be registered.
